statements.t: The Company expects the Acquisition to close before the end of 2026 (the date of such closing, the “Acquisition Closing Date”), subject to the satisfaction or waiver of the applicable closing conditions; however, there can be no assurance that the Acquisition will be completed on the anticipated terms or timeline, or at all.

The Company intends to fund the Acquisition and related fees and expenses with a combination of cash on hand, borrowings under the CVR Energy ABL (as defined below), the proceeds of senior secured indebtedness (the “Permanent Financing”), the proceeds of the equity investments described below and the net proceeds of a registered public offering of the Company’s common stock (the “Equity Offering”).
• The Company has undertaken a project to replace the hydrofluoric acid catalyst alkylation unit at the Wynnewood Refinery with a fixed bed catalyst system.

• In connection with our settlement with the EPA on certain environmental issues at the refinery in Coffeyville, Kansas (the “Coffeyville Refinery”) entered into in 2023 and by the court in January 2024, the Company is in the process of installing a flare gas recovery system along with other improvements at a cost of approximately $53 million, which is expected to be operational in late 2026.
With final approval by the UAN GP Board, we expect to proceed with construction in 2028.
Diesel crack spreads remain elevated in 2026 and we expect this to continue until global supply chains normalize.

Actions taken by the EPA under the RFS, the outcomes of RFS-related legal challenges, and legislative and regulatory developments affecting renewable fuels have materially impacted our results in the past and are expected to continue to do so.

In addition, certain governmental regulations and incentives affecting the automobile transportation, agricultural, and renewable fuels industries, including those related to corn-based ethanol, biodiesel, renewable diesel, and sustainable aviation fuel production and consumption, have impacted, and are expected to continue to impact, our business.
These provisions are expected to support demand for domestic corn and soybean oil feedstocks which may affect both our refining and fertilizer operations.

• Certain governmental regulations and incentives associated with the automobile transportation, agricultural and renewables industries, including the ones related to corn-based ethanol and vegetable oil-based biodiesel, renewable diesel, and sustainable aviation fuel production or consumption, have impacted, and is expected to continue to impact, our business.
Given the current geopolitical events, we believe the structural shortage of natural gas in Europe will continue to be a source of volatility through at least 2027.

Certain external factors, such as volatile commodity prices, industry utilization rates, and market inventory supply, have adversely impacted and are expected to continue to adversely impact our businesses, particularly within our Petroleum segment.
There can be no assurance that we will be able to do any of the foregoing or that any of the foregoing will be undertaken or, if pursued, completed on favorable terms.

The Board will continue to evaluate the economic environment, the Company’s liquidity needs, optimal uses of cash, payment of dividends (if any), and other relevant factors, and may elect to make additional changes to the Company’s capital allocation in future periods.
We undertake growth capital spending based on the expected return on incremental capital employed, which is typically funded by reserves taken in prior years.
Our estimated capital expenditures are subject to further change due to changes in capital projects’ cost, scope, and completion time.
For example, we may experience labor or equipment cost changes necessary to comply with government regulations or to complete projects that sustain the operations of the refineries or facilities.
We will continue to monitor market conditions and make adjustments, if needed, to our current capital spending or turnaround plans.
Looking ahead, we remain optimistic about the near-term outlook while we seek to close on our transformative transaction with Marathon Petroleum by the end of the year.”
